description: lib/kernel.fz defines % as arithmetic remainder (def (left :: integer) % (right :: integer) ... with int/float clauses and, since fz-sc8.62, a default clause raising ArithmeticError). Elixir has no % operator: % only opens %{} and %Struct{}; remainder is rem/2 and Integer.mod/2. The epic's goal says fz moves toward Elixir surface syntax, and the operator cannot have an oracle fixture (fz-sc8.62 noted this). Decide: retire % (delete the clauses, their fz_op_rem_* wiring and fixtures that use it, pointing users at rem/2), or keep it and document it as an fz extension. Recommendation: retire.
title: The percent operator has no Elixir counterpart
